_about: Wording and laboratory details of the test report (layout: the lab's 'Transformer Test report format', see report.py). It is read each time a report is built, so no restart is needed. Point ALETHEIA_TEMPLATE at another file to use a different one. Keys left out fall back to the defaults in report.py.
title: TEST REPORT
_clauses: Clause numbers of IS 1180 (Part 1): 2014 printed in the summary table of tests conducted.
_temperature_limits_standard: Printed in the 'Limit as per the standard' column of the temperature-rise table (deg C). To be confirmed by the lab; the checks use the limits on the proforma.
